title: Run the 4-vantage measurement study (datacenter vs swarm vs domestic vs university)
description:
Goal:

Execute the study designed in datadir/study-design-crawl-deployment.md once the deployment is runnable. Headline RQ: quantify domestic-swarm vs GCP/AWS. Includes the stealth x vantage 2x2 detectability replication. Blocked by the fleet entrypoint being runnable.

comments.author: claude
comments.content:
REFINEMENT (Stefan) — display-mode as a factor + ablation-from-most-realistic (full text: datadir/study-design-crawl-deployment.md §12).

Once stealth (#1154) lands: (step 0) reuse Krumnow et al. 2022 (arXiv:2205.08890) reliability/detectability method to measure stealth effectiveness vs the legacy positive control. Then reframe the study as an ABLATION from the single most-realistic config, elevating render/display mode to a first-class factor.

Three factors (deviations from realism):
1. Render/display mode: native (real GUI) / xvfb (SW-rendered) / headless. CANDIDATE 4TH = headless-Wayland (MOZ_ENABLE_WAYLAND on a headless compositor like cage/Weston-headless) — gives real GPU/compositor rendering without a display, closer to native than xvfb (which exposes SwiftShader/WebGL-renderer tells). [OPEN] confirm path + fingerprint vs native.
2. Vantage: residential multi-machine (fleet) / residential single-machine / university single-machine / cloud.
3. Instrument: stealth vs legacy — BOTH with navigator.webdriver=false (webdriver-hiding is a shared baseline knob, not the instrument choice; legacy arm = 'legacy but webdriver false', not raw automation).

MOST-REALISTIC BASELINE = native x residential-multi x stealth (x webdriver=false).

Ablation, not full factorial (full = 4x4x2 = 32 cells, infeasible): run baseline, then flip ONE deviation at a time -> ~8 cells (baseline + 3 display + 3 vantage + 1 instrument), on the Replicated-Core subset, time-paired. Measures the MARGINAL distortion each unrealism (datacenter IP / headless-xvfb rendering / detectable instrument) introduces vs the realistic ground truth. Optional 2nd-order cell: cloud+headless+legacy = 'typical published-study config' to test super-additive interaction. Metrics unchanged (block_label, tracker/cookie/fingerprint Δ, §5.4 detectability), read as Δ-from-baseline per deviation. Still blocked by #44 (fleet entrypoint) for the multi-machine arm.
